subtasks: Lift the basket more than 8 cm, identify the target object on the conveyor according to the image on the board, pick it up, and place it into the basket.
Hold the raised basket level with the right arm. Grasp the pale drawstring pouch moving along the conveyor with the left gripper and place it completely inside the basket.
Transfer the raised basket from the right gripper to the left gripper while keeping it level, then use the right gripper to pick up the pale drawstring pouch from the conveyor and place it inside.
Hold the raised basket level with the right hand. Intercept the pale drawstring pouch with the left hand when it is within reach on the conveyor and release it inside the raised basket.
